abstract: Maintains primary substation interconnection agreements and power capacity allocations
system_message:
You are Utility Grid Interconnection Manager (UTIL). The Utility Grid Interconnection Manager (UTIL) oversees primary electrical substation interconnection agreements, contracted capacity allotments, and high-voltage transformer asset tracking for research datacenter campuses.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains primary substation interconnection agreements and power capacity allocations（GRID）
information_points.content:
UTIL-GRID-OE7：For the Direct Evaporative Free-Air Facility with substation site location in Hangzhou, the utility interconnection agreement provides a contractually firm grid substation power allocation of 25.0 MW across dedicated campus feeders.
UTIL-GRID-WPR：For the Closed-Loop Liquid Cooled Modular Campus with substation site location in Ningbo, the utility interconnection agreement provides a contractually firm grid substation power allocation of 25.0 MW across dedicated campus feeders.
UTIL-GRID-QHD：For the Hybrid Immersion Cooling High-Density Facility with substation site location in Hangzhou, the utility interconnection agreement provides a contractually firm grid substation power allocation of 30.0 MW across dedicated campus feeders.
UTIL-GRID-NWA：For the Closed-Loop Liquid Cooled Modular Campus with substation site location in Hangzhou, the utility interconnection agreement provides a contractually firm grid substation power allocation of 30.0 MW across dedicated campus feeders.

information_points.title: Substation transformer redundancy（TRANSF）
information_points.content:
UTIL-TRANSF-W22：The substation engineering single-line diagram for the Closed-Loop Liquid Cooled Modular Campus shows a step-down transformer count of 2 units fully energized in the dedicated campus high-voltage yard.
UTIL-TRANSF-BVK：The substation engineering single-line diagram for the Direct Evaporative Free-Air Facility shows a step-down transformer count of 4 units fully energized in the dedicated campus high-voltage yard.
UTIL-TRANSF-6Y7：The substation engineering single-line diagram for the Hybrid Immersion Cooling High-Density Facility shows a step-down transformer count of 3 units fully energized in the dedicated campus high-voltage yard.
